questions.q: Which of the following organs secretes the releasing factor that stimulates the pituitary gland to release growth hormone?
questions.explain: The hypothalamus produces Growth Hormone-Releasing Hormone (GHRH), which signals the anterior pituitary gland to secrete Growth Hormone (GH) into the bloodstream.
